text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Arima Kinen. Though Narita Brian is called the strongest, she says it's all because of my help.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rising star Mayano Top Gun and recently recovered Biwa Hayahide are also racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With unwavering confidence, Narita Brian boldly goes to face her rivals!
